# All

## Javascript

```{r, echo = F}
# Nom du thème cliquable vers sa page (comme la table datasets de data/index),
# au lieu d'une colonne "Link" séparée.
themes %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    theme = sprintf('<a href="https://fgeerolf.com/data/%s.html">%s</a>', theme, theme),
    Title
  ) %>%
  reactable::reactable(
    searchable = TRUE,
    pagination = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 20,
    showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
    pageSizeOptions = c(5, 10, 15, 20),
    compact = TRUE,
    resizable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    wrap = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = reactable::colDef(
      align = "left",
      headerStyle = list(fontWeight = "bold"),
      style = list(whiteSpace = "normal", wordBreak = "break-word")
    ),
    columns = list(
      theme = reactable::colDef(html = TRUE, minWidth = 90, maxWidth = 200),
      Title = reactable::colDef(minWidth = 160)
    )
  )
```

## Flat

```{r, echo = F}
themes %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    theme = sprintf('[%s](https://fgeerolf.com/data/%s.html)', theme, theme),
    Title
  ) %>%
  gt() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = "theme")
```
